verdict.rationale: Pilot's marketing mentions 'Instant AI answers about past transactions and current cash flow, plus run scenarios to plan ahead' (pilot-docs-7), suggesting some in-app AI query capability, but the rest of the evidence describes human bookkeepers and CFOs as the core service, not an agentic AI assistant that can be delegated tasks. Missing for 10: detail on what tasks the AI can actually execute (vs. just answer questions), any UI/workflow documentation, and independent/hands-on confirmation that this AI feature exists and works as an assistant.
